spans.s: vaicikitsa, adj. (to Skt. vicikitsā plus -a; cf. Pali vecikicchin, in which -in seems to be due to influence of kaṃkhin which regularly precedes in Pali), characterized by doubt: (tyakto …) ˚tso tathā martyo Mmk 〔551.2〕 (vs).
? vaicchetuka, intended as n. of some people or rather their mode of writing, in ramaṭhābhaya-(text ˚ṭhabhaya-)˚kā (sc. lipī, in list of scripts): Mv 〔i.135.7〕.
